mathematical community. This article provides an informal overview of the field from the point of view of a researcher

systems are organised, how much attention and public funding the topic now receives, including the European RAISE

evidence.excerpt:
The AI scientist in its new, software sense is no longer a thought experiment. It writes papers that pass review, 
and with enough compute and a good formal checker it can settle problems that resisted people for generations. 
It is also much better at carry ing out research than at choosing it, and better at producing answers than 
understanding. After more than twenty years of watching the boundary move between what the researcher does 
and what the machine does, one finds that this time the boundary has moved to the part of the job that was always 
the most important: asking the right question and knowing why the answer is right. That is where the research 
community should take it from here.

This research received no external funding.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The manuscript synthesizes independent external benchmarks and formal verification outcomes from existing literature.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Literature benchmarks, documented case studies, and verified formal checks reported in reviewed studies.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Not applicable; this is a state-of-the-art review article with no internal model training, selection, or optimization loop.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: The claims that AI scientists excel in automated-verification settings but remain limited in question formulation and conceptual understanding are fully aligned with the referenced evidence.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The review grounds its assessment in empirical findings from literature, contrasting headline successes against error rates, benchmark underperformance (such as PaperArena and ReplicationBench), and conceptual blind spots.

evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Literature benchmarks, documented case studies, and verified formal checks reported in reviewed studies.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Not applicable; this is a state-of-the-art review article without an internal model training, selection, or optimization loop.

primary.limitations: The work clearly addresses limitations, including systemic vulnerabilities in LLM-as-reviewer setups, high compute costs, and risks regarding scientific credit and understanding.
primary.method_assessment: As a review paper, it clearly identifies the architectural patterns of modern autonomous scientific systems (idea generation, tool-calling execution, and self-review loops) and contextualizes them using documented case studies and benchmark results.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript offers a scoped, balanced, and well-contextualized state-of-the-art review that appropriately integrates empirical evidence, policy context, and theoretical caveats regarding autonomous AI systems in science.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript provides a structured state-of-the-art review synthesizing the development, institutional landscape, capabilities, and fundamental limitations of autonomous 'AI scientist' agentic systems as of 2026.
